transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… I guess my eating’s been kind of off lately. For a few weeks I’ve been skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, and then at dinner I just pick at it, even when my wife made something. My jeans feel a little loose now, so… I figured I should bring it up.
Have you been trying to lose weight?

No, not really. I haven’t been trying to. I just… haven’t had much appetite, I guess. I skip meals without thinking, and then dinner doesn’t really sound good either. My jeans being loose is what made me notice.
Have you been happy about the weight loss?
No… not happy, exactly. It’s more that I noticed my jeans getting loose and realized I’d been skipping meals and barely eating dinner. That’s why I brought it up.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
I don’t think so… I mean, I haven’t really been worrying about gaining weight. I just noticed I wasn’t eating much.
Do you think you would be upset if you gained back the weight you lost?

I don’t think I’d be upset, no. It’s not really about the weight for me. I just noticed that for a few weeks I’ve been skipping breakfast and lunch without meaning to, and then kind of picking at dinner… even when my wife cooks. Then my jeans started feeling loose, so… that’s what made me mention it.
Are you afraid of eating?
No… I wouldn’t say I’m afraid of eating. I just haven’t felt that interested in it, I guess.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried about your eating habits?

A little, I guess. Not worried like… afraid of food or anything. It’s more that I noticed I keep skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, and then I barely eat dinner. My jeans feeling loose is what made me think maybe I should mention it.
How much weight do you think you've lost since you started skipping meals?
I’m not really sure exactly. I haven’t weighed myself. I just noticed over the last few weeks I’ve been missing meals and my jeans feel looser, so… maybe some, but I couldn’t give a number.
Is the lack of interest in eating due to not feeling hungry or is it because you're just not interested in food itself?

I think it’s more that I’m just not really interested in food. Like, I’ll skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, and then at dinner I kind of just pick at it, even if my wife cooked. That’s what made me notice it… and my jeans being loose.
Do you feel sad or depressed when you think about eating or when you're supposed to eat?

Not really about eating specifically. It’s more… most days lately I wake up feeling kind of heavy and flat. The apartment feels too quiet, and even picking up my guitar doesn’t really do much. Eating just kind of falls into that, I guess.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight, like more than 5% of your body weight, since this started?
I don’t know if it’s that much. I haven’t checked. I just know the last few weeks I’ve been skipping breakfast and lunch, not eating much dinner, and my jeans feel looser.
Do you think your lack of interest in food is related to the heavy and flat feeling you wake up with most days?
Yeah… I think so. It’s like I wake up feeling heavy and kind of flat most days, and then food just doesn’t really register. Same as with the guitar, it doesn’t really lift me much.
Have you noticed any other changes in your body besides your jeans feeling loose, that might suggest you've lost a substantial amount of weight?

Not really anything obvious. Just… what made me notice was the eating being off these past few weeks. I skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, then I just pick at dinner, even when my wife made it. And yeah, my jeans feel looser.
Do you think you would have more interest in food if you weren't feeling heavy and flat most days?

Probably, yeah. I mean, what made me bring it up is just that my eating’s been off the past few weeks… skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, then just picking at dinner, even when my wife cooked. And my jeans are starting to feel loose.
Do you think your lack of interest in food would change if your overall mood improved?

Yeah, I think it might. I mean… the main thing is just these past few weeks I haven’t really been eating right. I skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, then at dinner I just kind of pick at it, even when my wife cooked. My jeans are getting a little loose, so… I guess if my mood lifted, maybe food would seem more normal again.
Do you think your lack of interest in food would improve if your mood were better?

Yeah… probably. I mean, I think it’s tied to that. It’s just been these past few weeks where I don’t really eat much—skip breakfast and lunch, then barely touch dinner. If I felt better, maybe I’d care about food again.
Do you think your lack of interest in food is more because of not feeling like yourself or because food itself doesn't appeal to you?

More not feeling like myself, I think. Food doesn’t exactly gross me out or anything… I just don’t think about it. I’ll miss breakfast and lunch, then at dinner I only pick at it, even if my wife made something. It’s been a few weeks like that. My jeans are a little loose now.
Do you think your lack of interest in food is related to thoughts about eating itself or more about your overall state of mind?

More my overall state of mind, I think. It’s not like food itself is the issue. I just… don’t really get around to eating. I’ll skip breakfast and lunch without meaning to, then barely eat dinner, even if my wife made it. My jeans feel a little loose lately, so that’s kind of what made me notice.
Do you think your lack of interest in eating is because of something about food or eating itself?

No, not really something about food itself. It’s more… I just don’t eat. Like I’ll skip breakfast and lunch without really meaning to, then just pick at dinner, even if my wife cooked. My jeans are starting to feel loose, so… that’s why I noticed it.
